blocks.text: Dear Harvest Partner, World changes, disasters of all kinds are striking the earth. Nations against nations. Out of this economic crisis it is leading all nations to a trade and currency war as well as nations leaving the dollar. Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa are forming a new banking system called The BRICS. In this letter we have the beginning of the great decline that will bring about the coming of the new world system and the anti-Christ. These prophecies cannot be denied that Brother Neal Frisby wrote. All one has to do is wait and see. I know you will enjoy this great prophetic letter from Brother Frisby’s library.

THE DECLINING U.S.A. – “According to some very good research, the average life span of the world’s great civilizations has been about 200 years to peak, and then suddenly they begin to decline because of moral decay and disregard for the Biblical truths! – Note these points were discovered, as each great power progressed through the following pattern: (1) From bondage to spiritual faith! (2) From spiritual faith to great courage! (3) From courage to liberty! (4) From liberty to abundance! (5) From abundance to selfishness! (6) From selfishness to complacency! (7) From complacency to apathy! (8) From apathy to dependency (socialism)! (9) From dependency to bondage!” (Rev. chap. 13) – “The people came here from all nations to escape religious and state persecution, and for the religious freedom found here! Although we will have a great outpouring to the elect, the United States will go from great courage and faith to a form of godlessness and finally denying the power thereof for a false religion!” Remember it will be exactly as Rev. 13:11-15, “at first it was like a lamb (religious freedom), but then spoke as a dragon (bondage) verse 18.” – “In 1976 the U.S.A. was 200 years old. And we are seeing a decline in many things.” PROPHECY DECLARES IT SO – “According to the prophets it has been predicted that there must be a decline in American status in the world because a new monolithic confederacy is to arise out of Western Europe. This 10 horn united giant (United Nations of Europe) and its 11th horn leader rising afterwards will bring all nations under his control.” PROPHECY DECLARES A CALCULATION DEVICE (Rev. 13:16-18) – Computers with artificial intelligence (light, etc.) will control all commerce and banking under its control. A computer code mark is given!” – “I believe that men will even go beyond this and discover life-like rays that will be used in various new inventions!” – “Through all of these inventions mankind is finally led to Armageddon! (Read Rev. 16:13-14). PROPHECY MARCHES ON – “Look for events concerning the Common Market (Western Europe)! Although the United States will disagree off and on with them in finality will be in a world trade trap! More nations are added and this will become World Commercial Babylon controlled by the anti-Christ system! Also watch a world political and government church called Mystery Babylon! (Rev. 17) – This electronic mistress will unite all false religions, bringing great persecution upon the earth! Even for a time riding and controlling the deadly beast of terror until it turns upon her!” (Rev. 17:16) – Continuing – “In the future we see a new economy appearing, a new political system and a new social and religious order! This appears out of perplexity, economic and social woes!” – “According to the Scriptures inflation returns more than ever before! It also predicts that our type of currency today will be done away with finally! As we can see all nations are caught up in the printing paper mania now! – In fact later, inflation becomes so terrible that the people of the earth will work a whole day just to buy a loaf of bread! (Rev. 6:6) And we also know that evidently before some of this that Commercial Babylon brings great prosperity! (Rev. 18) – It seems craft prospers under the magic touch of the dictator! (Dan. 8:25) PROPHECY UNFOLDING – Dan. 9:26 revealed, “the end thereof shall be with a flood.” We can predict of a surety that a sudden wave of events will take place in the political, financial, religious and scientific world and unusual changes just before the return of Jesus that will shake the foundations of society. These events will be of such magnitude that some of the events of the past will seem insignificant! “I foresee the people then are going down the road of doom! The vision is they are like walking into a delusive vapor of smoke that is disintegrating in the flames of no turnabout! – Real Christianity is literally evaporating or fading from the earth! It is the time of consummate wickedness! The rise of idols, abominations, the image of satan rising out of tumult! – The people will become hypnotized, charmed, into a fantasy world of worship of man! They are like drug addicts enslaved, spellbound by a master deceiver!” End quote. – Next month we will continue this letter into Part 2.

This month we are releasing a wonderful book called “The Sign – The Handwriting on the Wall” and also a DVD called “Deception and Deception.” – This summer we have a wonderful project to send many books, CD’s and cassettes to the foreign lands. Your prayers and your support will never be as important as it is this month. There’s always a great reward and blessing for those helping to publish this valuable message as the age closes out.
